precepts.text: The armies gathered with Gog are named, Persia, Ethiopia, Libya, Gomer, and Togarmah, showing Esau conspiring to draw all the other nations to come against Israel.
precepts.point: This is the same setting as Revelation 20, when Satan is loosed in both the spiritual and the physical form: the spiritual demon Satan and the physical Esau. The Most High smites the bow out of Gog's left hand and causes his arrows to fall out of his right hand, so no weapon formed against Israel will prosper. He smacks their weapons out of their hand and their weapon is for naught.

note.label: Ezekiel 39: The Fall of Gog and the Gathering of Israel

precepts.why:
Gog is “the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal”, and Magog is the land of Russia. Whoever comes out of the land of southern Georgia and Russia we know from the scriptures is Esau. Chapter 38 sets it up: the Most High sets His face against “Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal”, and says “I will turn thee back, and put hooks into thy jaws, and I will bring thee forth, and all thine army, horses and horsemen, all of them clothed with all sorts of armour, even a great company with bucklers and shields, all of them handling swords”.

Then the armies gathered with him are named: “Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them; all of them with shield and helmet: Gomer, and all his bands; the house of Togarmah of the north quarters, and all his bands: and many people with thee.” That is Esau conspiring to draw all the other nations to come against Israel.

This is all prophecy, going forward to the time after Christ has taken down the other nations, when Israel will be in their land. He brings Gog up from the north parts upon the mountains of Israel, leaves but the sixth part of him, and smites the bow out of his left hand and the arrows out of his right, so no weapon formed against Israel will prosper.

“After many days thou shalt be visited”: saying the same thing. “Thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword, and is gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel”: once they are loosed they will come against the land of Israel, gathered back. “And they shall dwell safely all of them”: the Israelites there will be dwelling safely, and then these nations come against us.

“Son of man, set thy face against Gog, the land of Magog, the chief prince of Meshech and Tubal.” “Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya with them.” “And many people with thee”: when these nations are released the party isn’t over. We will be the top nation on the planet, and they will be jealous and say they have to destroy us again.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

precepts.why:
After the thousand years are expired, Satan is loosed out of prison. He goes out to deceive the nations in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, and gathers them in a number like the sand of the sea. They surround the camp of the saints and the beloved city, and fire comes down from God out of heaven to devour them.

That is the timing of Ezekiel 38. The white man is released after the thousand years, gathers the nations against the kingdom, and God destroys that assault. Applying Gog and Magog to the people currently occupying the land overlooks both the thousand years and the condition of the restored people dwelling safely.

points: After many days thou shalt be visited by our Lord, and in the latter years come into the land brought back from the sword and gathered out of many people, against the mountains of Israel which have been always waste, and they shall dwell safely, all of them.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Are the Israelis dwelling safely? They are in bomb shelters, running and crying about the unsanitary conditions. Where is their god, on vacation, with Epstein, at Starbucks? The land of unwalled villages with neither bars nor gates is not the land of walls over there today.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Greg Laurie’s whole sermon is based on Ezekiel 38: Israel will be attacked by a nation to her north; not yet, but in process. Ezekiel 38 ain’t talking about them people that live over there. His checklist: scattered to the four corners of the earth, check; regathered, check. So these white people that came from Poland, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Uzbekistan, that’s the four corners of the earth? Whoever believes that is an idiot. Ask the white men in Israel: where is the tribe of Issachar, where’s Manasseh, where is Gad, where is Reuben, where’s Benjamin, where’s Ephraim and Zebulon, Naphtali? Where they at? They just lie, and our people in these churches fall for the okey-doke because of his red pink skin.

“Thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword”: brought back from destruction, from judgment, “and is gathered out of many people”: the Israelites come out of many nations, “and they shall dwell safely all of them.” Are those people over there dwelling safely? No, hell no. So this chapter is not talking about this time period.

note.label: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

points: “I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely”. Are they at rest over there? No. They don’t dwell safely over there; it’s always some kind of problem over there. “Having neither bars nor gates”: we’ve been there, and there’s bars and gates around the land. This has nothing to do with those people over there today. It is Revelation 20: after the thousand years, when Satan is loosed and the nations come up against the saints and the beloved city.
